messages.content: Analyze public web search results for this query: "official open law docs". Call web_search with that query and return source links. Do not use skills_search as a substitute.

arguments.title: Search official open law docs
arguments.code: const r = await web_search({query:"official open law docs", count:10}); text(r);

The results mix official government sources with commercial legal services. For authoritative U.S. law and government documents, start with:

- [GovInfo — U.S. Government Publishing Office](https://www.govinfo.gov/) — official federal publications.
- [National Archives: Public Laws](https://www.archives.gov/federal-register/laws) — links to official public-law texts.
- [FOIA.gov](https://www.foia.gov/) — information about requesting federal records.
- [National Archives: Government Documents](https://www.archives.gov/research/alic/reference/govt-docs.html) — government-document guides and links.

Other results, such as LawDiver, OpenDocs, OpenLaw, OpenLaws, and LawDepot, are not official government sources.
